# Tom Pickup

> The website of Tom Pickup, Reform UK county councillor for Padiham and Burnley West on Lancashire County Council and its Cabinet Member for Adult Social Care. It publishes investigations into public spending and local decisions in Burnley, Padiham and Lancashire, and working papers deposited on Zenodo with their data and code.

Every published figure names its source document. Articles carry numbered sources and, where a dataset exists, a "Data behind this article" box. Corrections are dated and stay on the page.

Content is written by Tom Pickup. Cite as Pickup, T. (year) with the page title and URL, or the DOI for working papers.

## Main pages

- [News and investigations](https://tompickup.co.uk/news/): all articles, by area and topic
- [Studies and working papers](https://tompickup.co.uk/studies/): deposited papers with DOIs, data and code
- [Lancashire council reorganisation](https://tompickup.co.uk/lgr/): the paused four-council plan and an interactive model
- [Stocks Massey](https://tompickup.co.uk/stocks-massey/): the Burnley bequest, its history and awards
- [About](https://tompickup.co.uk/about/): roles, record and declared interests
- [Press and researchers](https://tompickup.co.uk/press/): method, data and contact routes
